Presale means you buy a home before it is built, and you take possession when it completes. This page lists every Surrey presale project on my list that is scheduled to complete between 2027 and 2029, with the developer, type, size and deposit where the sources publish them.
New homes listed on the MLS® now in Surrey

The search above shows active Surrey listings that the MLS® records with an age of 0 or less. That picks up homes completed this year and homes listed before completion, in three types (houses, townhomes and condos), with land and income properties left out. The MLS® carries only part of the new-home market: developers sell many presale homes directly and list them late.
What newer homes in Surrey have sold for
Cedar Hills led Surrey for newness over November 2025 to October 2026. duplexes that sold there had a median build year of 2026 (8 sales, median price $1,163,690).

6 of 37 sub-area and home-type groups with 5 or more sales had a median build year of 2020 or later. The newest were Cedar Hills duplexes (built 2026), Fraser Heights townhomes (built 2025), Cedar Hills townhomes (built 2025) and Fleetwood Tynehead condos (built 2022).

blocks.text: Surrey presale projects at a glance

The list holds 25 presale projects in Surrey with estimated completion between 2027 and 2029: 16 in 2027, 6 in 2028, 3 in 2029. By type, that is 20 condo projects, 4 mixed condo and townhome projects, 1 townhome project.

5 of the 25 have a price published and dated within the last three months. The lowest published starting price is at Bourna on 105A (Bourna 2.0): 1-bedroom homes from $379,900. For the other 20, the price is either not published or the price I have is too old to show, so ask me for the current list.
A deposit structure is published for 10 of the 25.
Developers with more than one project here: Zenterra Developments (3), Quadra Homes (2), Dawson + Sawyer (2), ML Emporio Properties (2), Genaris Properties (2).
The largest project with a confirmed home count is Whalley Station at 550 homes.

faq.q: How many presale projects are completing in Surrey between 2027 and 2029?
faq.a: 25 projects are on my list as of November 2026: 16 completing in 2027, 6 completing in 2028, 3 completing in 2029. The list covers projects marketed publicly. Projects sold only through private channels may be missing.

faq.q: What kinds of presale homes are being built in Surrey?
faq.a: The mix is 20 condo projects, 4 mixed condo and townhome projects, 1 townhome project.

faq.q: What should I read before buying a condo in Surrey Presale?
faq.a: The Form B, the bylaws, the last two years of strata minutes, the depreciation report and the contingency reserve fund balance. They show planned repairs, special levies and rules on pets and rentals.

faq.q: What do strata fees cover on a condo in Surrey Presale?
faq.a: Strata fees pay for upkeep and insurance of the common property and the contingency reserve fund, and in some buildings heat, hot water or other services. The Form B Information Certificate lists exactly what a unit's fee covers.
